title: Calculator UI & Form Submission
user_story: As a user, I want a plain HTML UI served at the root route / with two number inputs, an operation picker for add/subtract/multiply/divide, and a Calculate button, so that I can enter my calculation request.
acceptance_criteria: The page loads at the root route /.
The interface contains two number input fields.
A selection control allows picking one of the four basic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide).
A Calculate button is present to submit the form.

title: Server-Side Calculation & Result Display
user_story: As a user, I want submitting the form to compute the result server-side and re-render the page with a labeled result area, so that I can view the outcome without leaving the page.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting the form triggers server-side computation.
The page re-renders after submission displaying the entered inputs and selected operation.
A clearly labeled Result area shows the computed value.
The calculation correctly handles addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

title: Input Validation & Error Handling
user_story: As a user, I want the app to validate inputs and handle edge cases gracefully, so that I receive clear feedback instead of errors or crashes.
acceptance_criteria: Displays an error message if number inputs are empty.
Rejects non-numeric entries with a validation warning.
Prevents division by zero and shows a specific error message.
Preserves entered values in the form fields after submission to avoid re-typing.
